text:
maya: Heads-up — planned window TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. We need to pin router -> v3.4.2 and promote the runtime console patch (rc-2026-03B). Cross-service checklist before we flip traffic.
sam: ETA on console schema change? Any migration scripts? also how long is the router pin expected to stay?
maya: Console change is non-migration (UI-only config key toggle), runtime has a KV header tweak that could affect router routing heuristics. Pin should be reversible within minutes; plan is 10% canary for 5m, 50% for 10m, then full if healthy.
lee: I ran synthetic smoke against staging with router v3.4.2 + rc-2026-03B — no failures, p95 latency +6ms. Logs: ```INFO routing: sticky-route preserved for long sessions
INFO kv: header-accept fallback engaged```
ash: Ops: confirm the rollback runbook. If we see p95 > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5% we roll back? Agree thresholds?
zara: +1 on thresholds. Add 5xx spike + sudden increase in tail latency for >2 consecutive minutes -> rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @maya at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
ops-bot: Reminder: quiet window enabled 01:50-02:30 UTC
sam: Quick commands for pin/rollback please (so oncall can act fast)
maya: Commands below — use with deploy-bot-confirm and @ops to execute:
```
# Pin router version
deploy-bot pin service=router version=3.4.2 --reason="runtime-console coord"
# Traffic shift
deploy-bot route service=router percent=10 monitor=5m
# Rollback
deploy-bot rollback service=router to-version=3.4.1 --urgent
```
lee: Also ensure console feature-flag is off by default during canary and only enabled once 50% pass. I'll prepare the flag toggle command.
ash: Metrics watchlist: router/p95, router/5xx_rate, console/error_rate, kv/cache_miss, runtime/cpu_util. Set alert if any exceeds threshold during canary.
zara: I'll run the short smoke test suite after each traffic step. If any smoke test fails -> immediate rollback and pin unlock.
maya: Rollback criteria summarized: any of -> p95 > 200ms sustained 2m, 5xx rate > 0.5% for 1m, smoke tests failing, or KV header mismatch rate > 0.2%.
sam: Do we need to coordinate with Dedicated teams (reserved capacity)? they might have pinned kernels.
maya: Good call — putting Dedicated owners on the thread. @lee can you confirm Dedicated compatibility with v3.4.2? If not, we'll hold full shift and keep pin to canary only.
lee: Dedicated reported no kernel conflicts. One pod in eu-west still on older runtime — that will be excluded from canary via routing policy.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 started by @maya — router=3.4.2 -> 10% at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z
ops-bot: Monitoring hooks: grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/r/router-canary-1768005555 :eyes:
maya: tagging release notes draft here: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-25-router-console — include rollback criteria and pin details.
zara: After 10m no red flags. Moving to 50% per plan.
maya: On 50% hold — waiting on Dedicated validation for 10 more minutes.
sam: If we need emergency rollback, who's primary? @ash is oncall this window.
ash: I'm oncall, will execute rollback if thresholds hit. @maya please set ops approval channel to /urgent-deploys.
lee: All clear from Dedicated. Proceed to full roll after 10m stable.
maya: Full shift started. I'll unlock the feature flag gradually at 25% increments.
zara: Final smoke passed. No regressions observed.
maya: Thanks team — releasing postmortem note and pin will be removed in 24h unless issues are seen. :tada:
